evidence.reason: At the current tip, `gitRemoteEnv` builds a command-scope config list containing only `credential.helper` and `core.askPass`; it does not set `protocol.ext.allow=never`. `assertPushUrl` validates only the pre-rewrite input string, so repository/global config with `protocol.ext.allow=always` plus a `url.*.insteadOf` rewrite can redirect an allowed https or local URL to the `ext::` transport for both `gitPushAtomic` and `gitLsRemoteRef`. Adding the suggested config entry is the smallest compatible fix and does not affect https/local-path remotes.
